scopeLimits: Source times use the previously frozen RMS-onset proxy; historical-intro/performance annotation uncertainty remains. No excerpt or label was changed after prediction.

Each model is evaluated separately using the same strict development baseline. Scores and calibrated qualification are not inherited across weights; these results do not prove that every possible candidate-specific policy would fail.
Offline/page/isolated Worker results do not prove production SDK capture-to-visible-comment, coupled rendering, total memory or server/network performance.
New independent recordings are not exposed before a candidate passes development gates. Default YAMNet frame qualification cannot qualify a new model.

decision.reason: Both best development variants pass only 41/53 positive recordings and fail the absolute quality gate. Both historical guitar recordings remain at zero correct coverage.
decision.nextStage: No candidate integration or new independent set; retain original failures and current production default.
decision.notClaimed: This does not prove that every alternative model-specific policy would fail, nor does it complete the wider P0 accuracy goal.

harnessCorrections: Initial zero-row module-worker run failed because the local server served wasm loader JavaScript with an unsuitable MIME type; corrected only in the private server.

A later zero-row module-worker run failed with ModuleFactory not set. The private worker was bundled as a classic worker, matching the app worker creation mode. Both failed reports remain in native evidence.
The owned page debugging binding survived navigation. A new owned page in the same task space was used for the final Worker runs; no global debugging flags or browser permissions changed.
